mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months, indicating a rapidly tightening labor market, will lead to wage inflation and reduced corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops >0.5pp in 3mo but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2pp year-over-year, signaling a potential supply chain disruption or weakening manufacturing sector, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y INDPRO growth slows >2pp but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3%, indicating a restrictive monetary policy stance, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 60 trading days as higher borrowing costs weigh on economic activity.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 3% but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When both real estate loans and housing starts are rising, indicating a strong housing market, consumer spending and economic growth tend to accelerate, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS and HOUST both rising Y/Y but SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 1% year-over-year while the unemployment rate is already above 7%, signaling a weak labor market, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y PAYEMS < -1% and UNRATE > 7% but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >45% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 4% while the federal funds rate is below 2%, indicating an inflationary environment with loose monetary policy, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates tighter policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 4% and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth accelerates by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter while the unemployment rate is below 5%, signaling strong economic momentum, S&P 500 returns tend to be positive over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Q/Q GDPC1 growth > 2% and UNRATE < 5% but SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances.
